title: Avnet Partners with Weston Robot on Edge AI Inspection Platform
summary: Avnet and Weston Robot announced a partnership on August 5, 2026 to launch a real-time autonomous inspection platform built on Unitree quadruped robots. Avnet supplies an edge-compute backpack powered by AMD Ryzen AI Embedded processors that delivers up to 50 TOPS of on-device AI performance for inspection, thermal and visual analytics, and 3D lidar mapping in GPS-denied environments. Singapore-based Weston Robot, which primarily resells Unitree hardware in a robots-as-a-service model, provides the fleet management software that lets the robot patrol a defined route and stop to investigate flagged sites. New inspection and recognition tasks can be trained and deployed directly to the robot using the onboard Avnet compute architecture.
whyItMatters: The partnership packages edge AI compute, autonomous navigation and fleet software into a deployable product rather than a research prototype, pushing physical-AI inspection out of pilots and into factories, warehouses, ports and utilities that need continuous, low-latency monitoring without reliable cloud connectivity.
